facts.statement: Recently installed asset fails. Investigation W10 is internally authorised; cause remains unknown. Manufacturer offers replacement part only, no labour/travel/access reimbursement. Registration was submitted, not accepted. Removed part is needed as claim evidence.
Engineer suspects third-party controls but has no verified conclusion. Manager and finance have not agreed customer charging. Costs so far: labour £200, travel £40, part £300; no recovery received.
